## History

Aaron was the brother of Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) Spofford. Fifty years prior, he brought a pair of century-old china dogs from [London](../codex/places.md#london) that were subsequently placed by the hearth at Patty's Place. Upon his death, he left Patty's Place to his sister in his will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P3](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0003), [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004), [v3 ch.Place P5](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0005), [v3 ch.Place P6](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0006), [v3 ch.Place P7](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P9](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0009), +39 more_
